summary: Oatly Group AB filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release announcing that the prospectus for its SEK 1,700 million senior secured floating rate Nordic Bonds, issued September 30, 2025, was approved and registered by the Swedish Financial Supervisory Authority on September 24, 2026. Admission to trading on Nasdaq Stockholm's Corporate Bond List is expected on or about September 28, 2026. No board recommendation or advisor named. This is a routine bond listing prospectus, analogous to a US exchange-listing registration for already-issued debt; no equity special situation, price, premium or deal terms apply. Watch financing covenants and liquidity.
